title: Household Accounts Note on CGM Payment Plans and the Insulin Pump Program
content:
The household extension of a payment plan on an Insulin Pump Program follows the customer's programs on the Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program: the customer's CGM payment plan requests and the balance of the customer's CGM program in active status.

| Customer's CGM records | Effect on the plan months |
|---|---|
| An approved payment plan on a CGM program, and an active CGM program whose balance is at least the pump tier's payment-plan minimum balance | 4 months (the long household extension) are added |
| An approved payment plan on a CGM program, and an active CGM program whose balance is below that minimum | 2 months (the short household extension) are added |
| Any other case, including where the customer holds no active CGM program | nothing is added |

The minimum balance is that of the pump program's tier:

| Pump program tier | Payment-plan minimum balance |
|---|---|
| Insulin Pump Self-Pay Program | $150.00 |
| Insulin Pump Commercial HMO Program | $150.00 |
| Insulin Pump Commercial PPO Program | $150.00 |
| Insulin Pump Medicare Advantage Program | $100.00 |
| Insulin Pump Original Medicare Program | $100.00 |
| Insulin Pump Medicaid Program | $100.00 |

## Cases (hypothetical, pump program on the Commercial PPO tier)

- Approved CGM payment plan; active CGM program balance $150.00: 4 months added.
- Approved CGM payment plan; active CGM program balance $149.99: 2 months added.
- Approved CGM payment plan; no CGM program is active: nothing added.
- Active CGM program with a balance of $500.00 but no approved CGM payment plan: nothing added.
